description: E222. `reasons`: why a document was not added, listed, served or described, one closed key each, one sentence each, no codes; nothing was stored. The file checks are byte tests, never the file name, applied in this order: E191's checks first (a PNG, JPEG or PDF is decided there), then spreadsheet, archive and text for a file that is none of the three, then not-a-document. `{bound}` is the bound that applied, as a person reads it; `{tag}` is the OSDU data-definitions tag of the served type list. A parent the reader may not read and an unknown parent are refused with the same sentence.

reasons.not-a-document: This file is not a PDF or a picture (PNG or JPEG), so it was not added.
reasons.text-file: This is a text file. Documents are PDFs or pictures (PNG or JPEG); save it as a PDF to add it.
reasons.spreadsheet: This is a spreadsheet. Tables are added as data, not as documents.
reasons.archive: This is an archive. Add the documents it holds one by one.
reasons.two-types: This file can also be read as a web page, so it was not added.
reasons.active-content: This PDF carries scripts, launch actions or embedded files, so it was not added.
reasons.damaged: This file says it is a PNG, JPEG or PDF but its structure cannot be read, so it was not added.
reasons.empty: This file is empty, so it was not added.
reasons.too-large: This file is larger than this deployment adds ({bound}), so it was not added.
reasons.type-not-listed: This type is not in OSDU's document type list ({tag}).
reasons.type-missing: A document needs its type from OSDU's list.
reasons.parent-unavailable: The well, wellbore, survey or project this document belongs to is not available to you.
reasons.unavailable: Documents are not added on this deployment yet.
